record: AISEF V2 — V2-RETRY-POLICY AMENDMENT 1: the V1-PF-001 lifecycle after its WP-4.2 replacement
authority: owner ruling 'AISEF V2 — CYCLE-2 OWNER RULING / V1-PF-001 POST-WP-4.2 POLICY RESOLVED / ORCHESTRATION CONFORMANCE REPAIR AUTHORIZED / QP-2.6 MUST BE REQUALIFIED ON THE NEW EXACT CANDIDATE' (2026-09-30), Ruling 1 and the policy conflict correction

amends.rule: the preregistered policy stays byte-identical (the P1 seal binds it); validation/v2/run_history.py overlays this amendment; without it every V1-PF-001 recurrence must STOP (fail closed)

conflict_resolved.register: V1-POST-FREEZE-DEFECTS.json: STOP on recurrence before WP-4.2 is complete
conflict_resolved.checker_before: run_history.entry_problems: any recorded recurrence must STOP, unconditionally
conflict_resolved.correction: a narrow validation/policy correction; frozen V1 code and V1 evidence untouched

record_only_requires: the replacement is complete: every replacement evidence file holds its stated fact
every failing test of the attempt fails with the known error type, innermost product frame the known component
every product frame of every failing traceback lies in the frozen V1 tree (aisef/), none in aisef2/
no failing test lies under tests/v2/
the attempt's V1 product tree and the tree being checked equal the frozen V1 tree
no Cycle-1 frozen evidence changed (the attempt's v1_evidence_changed and the fact both false)
a V2 process-range / ownership qualification record is named by path and sha256, holds that sha256 and says GREEN
no attempt of the history shows the error in the V2 path

shape.v1_product_tree: git tree of aisef at the attempt

rules: An attempt attributed to V1-PF-001 carries gate_effect STOP, or RECORD_ONLY only when the lifecycle derives RECORD_ONLY from its typed facts; STOP is always admissible (a stricter recorder is never wrong).
RECORD_ONLY keeps the attempt a FAIL: it is recorded, never counted as a pass, never a retry, never erased; it does not block a Cycle-2 gate.
The decision derives from typed defect identity, replacement state, code-path ownership and immutable tree identity; never from a CI run id or a commit id.
